# Serve client script against a fixture server; NOT_RUN. Counts of create
# and delete calls are checked by TestServeScripts.

# Invalid input is refused before any request.
! skygo serve up unknown.yaml --name web --target kube
stderr 'field color not found'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! skygo serve up setup.yaml --name web --target kube
stderr 'unsupported service feature: setup'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! skygo serve up web.yaml --name web
stderr 'requires --name and --target'
! skygo serve up web.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id req-1
stderr 'given together'
! skygo serve status not-an-id
stderr '32 lowercase hexadecimal'
! skygo serve forward 00000000000000000000000000000001 --listen 0.0.0.0:0
stderr 'loopback IP address'

# A new create needs the target's fixed-services capability.
! skygo serve up web.yaml --name web --target jobs
stderr 'target "jobs" does not advertise fixed-services-v1'
! stderr 'request-id:'

# Create prints its request domain and ID first. The same pair and request
# replays the same service; the same pair with another spec is refused and
# not retried.
skygo serve up web.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr '^request-domain: '$DOMAIN'$'
stderr '^request-id: req-1$'
stdout '^0{31}1 +web +kube +1 +present +creating +1 +0 +-$'
skygo serve up web.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stdout '^0{31}1 +web'
! skygo serve up other.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr 'retry with --request-domain '$DOMAIN' --request-id req-1'
stderr 'request_reused'

# A new request samples the current domain once and picks a fresh ID.
skygo serve up other.yaml --name other --target kube
stderr '^request-id: [0-9a-f]{32}$'
stdout '^0{31}2 +other +kube'

skygo serve status 00000000000000000000000000000001
stdout 'web +kube +1 +present +creating'
skygo --json serve status 00000000000000000000000000000001
stdout '"phase": *"SERVICE_PHASE_CREATING"'
skygo serve status
stdout '^0{31}1 +web +kube +present +creating +1 +0$'
stdout '^0{31}2 +other +kube'

# An undeclared enum value from the server is refused, not printed.
! skygo serve status 22222222222222222222222222222222
stderr 'invalid service phase'
! stdout .
! skygo --json serve status 22222222222222222222222222222222
! stdout .

# A name that would forge output columns is refused, not printed.
! skygo serve status 33333333333333333333333333333333
stderr 'invalid service name'
! stdout .

# Down latches the service absent under the revision it names and prints
# the pair and revision to replay it; an exact replay returns the same view.
skygo serve down 00000000000000000000000000000001 --request-id del-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN --record-revision 1
stderr '^record-revision: 1$'
stdout '^0{31}1 +web +kube +2 +absent +deleting'
skygo serve down 00000000000000000000000000000001 --request-id del-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN --record-revision 1
stdout '^0{31}1 +web +kube +2 +absent +deleting'
! skygo serve down 00000000000000000000000000000001 --request-id del-2
stderr 'given together'

-- web.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}
scaling: {replicas: 1}
-- other.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web, --other]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}
scaling: {replicas: 1}
-- unknown.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
color: blue
-- setup.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}
scaling: {replicas: 1}
setup: [make]
